mutants.name: carry_before_use
mutants.desc: carries pairs to the next bit before consuming the needed bit at this level

mutants.name: desc_greedy_strict
mutants.desc: largest-first greedy; discards a too-big element only if the rest sum is strictly greater than remaining target

mutants.name: impossible_le
mutants.desc: impossibility check off by one: returns -1 when sum(nums) <= target

mutants.name: no_carry
mutants.desc: bitwise greedy that splits a larger power when a bit is missing but never combines leftover smaller pieces

mutants.name: split_counts_one
mutants.desc: counts splitting 2^j down to 2^i as a single operation instead of j-i
